item.description:
Harmony for Mac now updates itself

Harmony no longer ships through TestFlight. This is the first build distributed directly as a disk image, signed and notarised by Apple.

  • Automatic updates. Harmony checks for a new version when it starts and once an hour after that. When one is available it asks before downloading or installing anything.
  • Check for Updates… is in the Harmony menu, next to About.
  • The app is now called Harmony in your Applications folder and Dock.

Installing: drag Harmony into Applications. If you still have the old TestFlight copy ("Renovation Projects macOS"), delete it first — your projects, tasks, payments and attachments all live in iCloud and will sync straight back.
